source_state: Dirty worktree; owner, fixture, manifest, runner, and binary hashes bind this focused rerun to the tested snapshot.

runner.command: cargo run --profile iteration -p quench-node-test --bin run-parallel-next -- --filter test-path-basename.js --timeout-secs 30; repeat with test-path-dirname.js

suite.selection: Two exact name-filtered upstream fixtures; filters are independent of the framework-core profile tags.

local_node_oracle.command: Execute byte-identical upstream fixtures through local Node v26.10.0 in a temporary CommonJS package scope, preserving fixture-relative test/parallel paths and the upstream test/common directory.

cases.obligation: POSIX and Win32 basename behavior, suffix removal, separators, drive roots, trailing separators, and ordinary path strings.
POSIX and Win32 dirname behavior for roots, drive-relative paths, UNC roots, trailing separators, and ordinary path strings.

limits: This qualifies only the two selected Path methods on the shared host and their byte-identical local Node oracle runs. It does not qualify the remaining Path API, full Node inventory, or Stage A gate.
